items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC9 each covered by vitest (missionAskItems, MissionAskCards) or the M5 Playwright spec; pending-question CTA kept per operator.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Non-record/string toolUseResult, empty answers, duplicate question text and multi-result lines all fall back without throwing; rejected question dropped.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Question/option/answer text rendered as React text nodes only; read-only, no input surface, no new route.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Unit tests for join/Other/multiSelect/rejected/pending/legacy; component tests; real-browser E2E with real JSONL, geometry and AA contrast; 74 existing mission E2E re-run green.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Pure reducer additions, O(questions); no timer, no new request.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files under 300 lines; session-parser.ts net-zero; removed dead FeedIcon/kindAccent; entry attr is data-entry-kind to avoid clashing with card data-kind selectors.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer Claude JSONL (tool_use input + top-level toolUseResult.answers) -> parser -> reducer -> DOM proven by E2E round trip.

items.name: Motion/A11y
items.note: No new motion; chosen option has check mark + sr-only (selected), not colour alone; tokens only, contrast asserted.
